ms.promise:
・Whitepaper Draft: A comprehensive document that outlines the functionality of the token, the ecosystem, and integrates initial exploration findings with technical and business strategies.
・Action Plan for Atala Integration: A detailed document outlining the steps, resources, and timelines for integrating Atala Prism with the project, including architectural schematics and use cases.
・Cardano-SDK Architecture Overview: Abstract schematic and documentation detailing the architecture of the Cardano software development kit (SDK) necessary for the project.
・Testnet Node Deployment: A functioning Cardano node running in the testnet environment to test the project’s blockchain interactions, including wallet creation and transaction processing.
ms.criteria:
1. Whitepaper Approval:
a. Metric: The whitepaper must achieve a minimum approval rate of 90% across all reviewers.
b. Documentation: Utilize document tracking software Google Docs (Soon at https://agrotcardano.com) to log all review comments, changes, and approvals. Each reviewer's credentials (e.g., industry relevance, technical expertise) will be documented.
c. Auditability:
i. Reviewed: Project team, technical advisors, selected agricultural producers, and key stakeholders. Each group must have documented expertise relevant to the project's vision, technology, and business strategy.
